comment: Windows wording rules for apps/windows/strings.py (DECISIONS.md D20, UX.md section 9). Overrides are .NET composite format strings in Windows sentence case.

overrides.connection.issue.networkPolicy.message: Network or system policy may be preventing this connection. Check firewall and VPN settings. This error does not identify which policy blocked access.
overrides.help.guide.listen.body: File > Listen for connections opens a listener. Give the server this PC’s network address and the displayed listening port, then accept or reject the incoming request. The first time you listen, Windows Firewall may ask whether TidyVNC can accept connections. Closing the listener stops waiting for new connections.
overrides.help.guide.failure.body: Check the address, gateway, server availability and authentication details. Retry is explicit. Use Disconnect or Cancel to stop the current attempt; exiting the app closes its connections.
overrides.credentials.the.saved.password.was.remov: The saved password was removed from this PC.
Windows Credential Manager is unavailable. Enter a password to continue.
overrides.credentials.the.keychain.operation.faile: The Credential Manager operation failed. No plaintext copy was saved.
overrides.settings.input.keyboard.capture.requires: Keyboard capture stops when the desktop loses focus. Ctrl+Alt+Del, Windows logo key+L and keys for apps running as administrator cannot be captured.
overrides.settings.input.press.these.modifiers.alo: Press these modifiers alone to release keyboard capture; add G to capture, M for the connection menu, or Enter for full screen.
overrides.settings.input.requires.macos.accessibil: Keyboard capture stops when this desktop loses focus. Ctrl+Alt+Del, Windows logo key+L and keys for apps running as administrator cannot be captured.
overrides.settings.scaling.on.a.retina.display.one: When Windows scales a display above 100%, one effective pixel spans more than one device pixel.
overrides.settings.input.shortcut.instructions: {0} alone releases keyboard capture. Add G to capture, M for the connection menu, or Enter for full screen. Add Space, release Space, then press a key to send that combination to the remote desktop.
overrides.settings.resize.closing.this.sheet.canno: Closing this dialog cannot undo a request already sent to the server.
overrides.settings.fullscreen.the.connection.chang: The connection changed. Close and reopen this dialog.
The connection’s resize settings changed. Close and reopen this dialog.
overrides.listener.start.a.listener.then.ask.the.r: Start a listener, then ask the remote VNC server to connect to this PC. Each accepted connection opens its own window.
overrides.document.the.file.format.uses.monitor.nu: The file format uses monitor numbers instead of saved display identities. Assign the numbers the receiving viewer should use, including for displays currently disconnected from this PC.
The remote clipboard could not be written on this PC. Copy it again to retry.
Keyboard capture is unavailable. Focus the desktop and try again.
overrides.presentation.issue.preferencesUnavailabl: TidyVNC could not open its settings store. Reopen the app and check that your Windows account can access its AppData folder.
overrides.presentation.issue.keyboardCaptureFailed: Keyboard capture could not start. Try again, or exit and reopen TidyVNC if it keeps failing.

windowsOnly.tunnel.error.windows.client.missing: The Windows OpenSSH Client is not installed. Add it in Settings > System > Optional features, then connect again.
windowsOnly.profiles.ssh.windows.client.missing: Install the OpenSSH Client in Settings > System > Optional features to use an SSH gateway.
